title: Terminal routes
what: The HTTP routes listing, opening, reading, renaming and ending terminal sessions, their pages and the session-id shape's refusal, in src/terminal/routes.rs.

title: Terminal sessions
what: The tmux server of the service's own that holds the terminal sessions, their ids and titles, their login environments, and starting, renaming and ending them, in src/terminal/tmux.rs.

title: Terminal socket
what: The websocket attaching one viewer's pseudo-terminal to a tmux session, carrying output in gathered binary frames and typed bytes and resize control messages, in src/terminal/socket.rs and src/terminal/pty.rs.
